about_the_game:
YUNODREAM is a game where you don't run from the nightmare — you move through it step by step, piecing together the memories pain has erased.

After a tragedy, Yuno returns to her quiet hometown — a place where time seems to move slower, and everything radiates calm and carefree simplicity. But this warmth remains on the outside. The house where she grew up now stands empty.

Then, reality begins to slip. The same streets, the same home — but now the walls whisper, the air grows heavy, and familiar objects seem to stare back. Yuno finds herself in a distorted version of the world around her — a space built from buried memories, raw emotions, and pain that was never fully faced. The only way through this nightmare isn’t to run, but to move through it, piecing together what was lost, one fragment at a time.

⠀

⠀

✦ Experience the contrast between the village’s bright, carefree atmosphere and the inner weight of its lone inhabitant

✦ Explore two parallel states of the same place — the familiar and the distorted

✦ Discover fragments of joyful memories to gradually piece together what was forgotten.

⠀

⠀

✦ A story not about escaping nightmares, but about learning to live with what cannot be changed

✦ Pixel art that emphasizes the visual contrast between worlds

✦ An atmospheric soundtrack reflecting the shift from bright innocence to a distorted perception of reality

✦ Approximately two hours of quiet, personal experience with a emotional impact.

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores themes of depression and contains scenes of violence, as well as references to suicide and death. Some players may find this content disturbing.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3+
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5+
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1/M2
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 540 or Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (64-bit)
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU or Intel Iris Plus Graphics 655
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: After the loss of her family, Yuno begins to see nightmares in broad daylight. In order to save herself, she must find happy memories in this distorted world. But will she be able to accept what has happened?
